invoices.contactHint: Fills the TRN, address, payment terms and place of supply.
invoices.einvoiceIssuesBody: The invoice was not e-invoiced. Fix each item below, then generate the e-invoice again.
invoices.marginSchemeHint: Price includes VAT; VAT is charged only on the margin over the purchase cost.
invoices.nudgeBody: {number} is a draft. Drafts are not counted as revenue until you issue the invoice.
invoices.nudgeIssuedBody: {number} is now counted in your revenue.
invoices.templateBankDetails: Bank details printed on the invoice
invoices.writeOffDescription: Posts the open balance to bad-debt expense and closes the invoice. Claim VAT bad-debt relief separately once the six-month condition is met.
invoices.writeOffDoneBody: {number} is closed and the balance is in bad-debt expense.
invoices.deleteBody: If this is your latest invoice number, the draft is deleted and its number is reused. Otherwise the draft is cancelled and its number stays on file, so numbering has no gaps. Issued invoices cannot be deleted.
invoices.einvoiceBuyerHint: E-invoicing is on for this company. A VAT-registered buyer needs a street, city and emirate on the contact before this invoice can be issued as an e-invoice.
invoices.recurringDeleteConfirm: This will permanently delete this recurring invoice schedule. This action cannot be undone.
invoices.supplierTrnRequiredBody: Your company is VAT registered but has no TRN. Add it in Company settings before issuing a tax invoice with VAT.
invoices.noTrnVatBody: Your company has no Tax Registration Number (TRN), so it cannot charge VAT. Set the VAT on each line to 0% (out of scope), or add your TRN in Company settings to issue a tax invoice.
invoices.currency.label: Currency
invoices.currency.rateHint: Leave blank to use the company rate for the date
invoices.currency.rateSuggested: Company rate for this date: {rate}. You can change it.
invoices.currency.rateMissing: No company rate saved for this date. Enter the rate, or add one under Exchange Rates.
invoices.currency.rateInvalid: Enter a positive rate with up to 6 decimals.
invoices.payment.rateHint: Leave blank to use the company rate for the payment date. A different rate from the invoice books a realised exchange gain or loss.
invoices.einvoiceIssue.buyerEndpointMiss: The buyer has no electronic address for the e-invoice. Add the customer's 15-digit TRN to the invoice or the customer, or record the customer's Peppol endpoint (scheme 0235 with its 10-digit TIN, or its own Peppol scheme and ID).
invoices.einvoiceIssue.buyerAddressMissi: The customer's address is incomplete for the e-invoice. Open the customer and fill in the street address, the city and the emirate, then check the invoice again.
invoices.einvoiceWhere.companyProfile: Fix it in Settings > Company profile
invoices.einvoiceWhere.customer: Fix it on the customer in Contacts
invoices.einvoiceWhere.invoice: Fix it by editing this invoice
invoices.draftCancelledBody: Later invoices already use the next numbers, so this draft's number is kept as cancelled to avoid a gap in the sequence.
invoices.creditNoteConfirmBody: The credit note reverses what is still open on this invoice (revenue and VAT) and keeps the original invoice on file.
invoices.currency.rateStale: Latest company rate is {rate}, saved for {date}. Check it or enter today's rate.
invoices.toastCreatedBody: Your invoice has been created with VAT calculation.
invoices.toastCreditNoteBody: A credit note has been created and the journal entry reversed.
invoices.toastPdfDownloadedBody: The invoice PDF has been downloaded.
invoices.toastBrandingBody: Your invoice customization settings have been saved.
invoices.recordPaymentDesc: Record a payment received for invoice {number} (total: {total})
invoices.noCashBankAccounts: No cash or bank accounts found. Create one in the chart of accounts.
invoices.chooseDepositFor: Choose where the payment for invoice {number} was deposited
invoices.shareDesc: Anyone with this link can view and download the invoice. It expires in 90 days.
invoices.shareLinkFailed: Could not create the share link
invoices.shareEmailNotConfigured: Email sending is not set up yet, so nothing was sent. Copy the link above and send it yourself.
invoices.shareEmailQueued: The email is queued for delivery, not yet sent. You can also copy the link above.
invoices.shareNotIssued: Issue the invoice before sharing it.
invoices.publicLinkExpiredBody: This invoice link has expired. Please contact the sender for a new link.
invoices.publicLinkInvalidBody: This invoice link is invalid or has been removed.
invoices.currency.pegNote: The dirham is pegged to the US dollar at 3.6725. You can change it for this invoice.
invoices.deposits.title: Customer deposits and advances
invoices.deposits.hint: VAT is due when an advance is received (FDL 8/2017 Art. 26). The deposit is held in 2050 until you apply it to the final invoice, which reverses the advance VAT so the supply is taxed once.
invoices.deposits.applyHint: Choose the customer's open invoice. The applied amount clears the receivable and reverses its share of the advance VAT.
invoices.deposits.failed: The deposit could not be saved
invoices.reminders.title: Payment reminders
invoices.reminders.description: Remind customers about overdue invoices, in English or Arabic.
invoices.reminders.emptyOverdueBody: Overdue invoices appear here with their next reminder.
invoices.reminders.loadError: Overdue invoices could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
invoices.reminders.howBody: Each overdue invoice moves through the steps below, at most once every {days} days.
invoices.reminders.autoHint: Due reminders are prepared as invoices age; you still review each one.
invoices.reminders.stepOff: Not used: the last step is set earlier.
invoices.reminders.noMessage: The standard wording is created with the first reminder.
invoices.reminders.editDescCustom: Saving updates your wording for this step.
invoices.reminders.editDescDefault: Saving keeps the standard wording and stores your own version for this company.
invoices.reminders.unknownFields: Remove the fields marked in grey; they would print as plain text.
invoices.reminders.timelineEmpty: No reminder has been sent for this invoice yet.
invoices.reminders.readyBody: Review the message, then copy it into your email.
invoices.reminders.autoEmailsBody: Emails sent before and after a due date, and for VAT deadlines.
invoices.reminders.emailNotReady: Automatic emails are prepared but not emailed yet. You can copy each reminder and send it yourself.
invoices.reminders.ruleSummary: {before} days before due · {after} days after · every {repeat} days · up to {max}
invoices.reminders.noRulesBody: Add a rule to email customers before or after a due date.
invoices.reminders.ruleDialogDesc: Choose when the email goes out and how it reads.
invoices.reminders.optionalBodyHint: Leave empty to use the standard bilingual wording.
invoices.reminders.bulkBody: Each invoice moves to its next reminder step.
invoices.activity.title: Sent and viewed
invoices.activity.desc: Every email of this invoice and every time the customer opened its link.
invoices.activity.viewed: The customer opened the invoice link
invoices.attachments.title: Attachments
invoices.attachments.desc: Keep the purchase order, delivery note or contract with the invoice.
invoices.attachments.hint: PDF or image · up to 2 MB each
invoices.attachments.tooLarge: A file is larger than 2 MB and was not added
invoices.attachments.uploadFailed: The file could not be attached
invoices.cashSale.title: Cash sale
invoices.cashSale.numberHint: Given when you save, from the cash sale series. Tax invoices keep their own series.
invoices.cashSale.desc: A sale paid on the spot: the invoice is issued and paid in one step.
invoices.cashSale.failed: The cash sale was not recorded
invoices.checks.allGood: Everything needed to finalise is in place.
invoices.checks.customerTrnInvalid: The customer TRN must be 15 digits.
invoices.checks.customerTrnEinvoice: E-invoicing is on: a VAT-registered customer's TRN is expected.
invoices.checks.lineQuantity: Line {n} needs a quantity above zero.
invoices.checks.linePrice: Line {n} needs a price above zero.
invoices.checks.companyTrnMissing: Your company has no TRN, so a line cannot charge VAT. Add the TRN or mark the line out of scope.
invoices.checks.placeOfSupply: Choose the place of supply (the emirate on the VAT return).
invoices.checks.dueBeforeDate: The due date is before the invoice date.
invoices.costCentre.label: Cost centre
invoices.creditFrom: Credit part or all of invoice {number}: remove lines or lower quantities.
invoices.dueDate.label: Due date
invoices.language.label: Document language
invoices.language.hint: The PDF is printed in this language; the other one stays alongside.
invoices.leave.title: Leave without saving?
invoices.leave.body: Your changes to this invoice will be lost.
invoices.notes.label: Notes and terms
invoices.notes.placeholder: Bank details, delivery terms, a thank-you note…
invoices.notes.issuedHint: Printed on the invoice. Notes, terms, due date and language can change after issue.
invoices.quoteSend.title: Email quote {number}
invoices.quoteSend.desc: The PDF is attached. A customer with a contact gets a link to accept or decline online.
invoices.quoteSend.messagePlaceholder: Optional: a short note to the customer
invoices.quoteSend.queuedBody: It goes out as soon as the email service accepts it.
invoices.quoteSend.noProvider: Email is not set up for this workspace, so the quote is queued and the quote stays a draft.
invoices.quoteSend.failed: The quote could not be emailed
invoices.receive.title: Receive payment
invoices.receive.desc: Apply one payment from a customer to several invoices.
invoices.receive.section.invoicesDesc: Auto apply pays the oldest due first. What is left becomes customer credit.
invoices.receive.chooseAccount: Choose a cash or bank account
invoices.receive.ratePlaceholder: Blank: the rate on file for the date
invoices.receive.pickFirst: Choose a customer to see their open invoices.
invoices.receive.noOpen: This customer has no open invoices.
invoices.receive.overApplied: The amounts applied are more than the payment.
invoices.receive.overInvoice: A payment is more than the invoice's open balance.
invoices.receive.bankNet: The bank receives {currency} {amount} after the fee.
invoices.receive.recordedCredit: The invoices are updated; {currency} {credit} is now customer credit.
invoices.recurringFrom: A schedule made from invoice {number}: each run is issued and emailed automatically.
invoices.section.termsDesc: When it is due, the language it is printed in, and what it says.
invoices.source.label: Source
invoices.terms.label: Payment terms
invoices.terms.hint: Filled from the customer; the due date follows.
invoices.receive.noCustomers: Payments are received from saved customers, and you have none yet.
invoices.deposits.error.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero, with at most 2 decimals.
invoices.deposits.error.paymentAccountId: Choose the account it was received into.
invoices.deposits.error.invoice: Choose the invoice to apply it to.
invoices.deposits.noCustomers: No customers yet. Add one to record a deposit.
invoices.issued.locked: This invoice is issued, so its customer, date and lines are locked. You can still change the notes, payment terms, due date and language below. To correct anything else, issue a credit note.
invoices.reminders.noMatchBody: Try a different customer name or invoice number.
invoices.reminders.pauseError: Could not update this invoice. Try again.
